fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (MU) has risen 123% as of 2026 but has fallen 32% since July, and is awaiting December fiscal 2027 Q1 earnings amid concerns over intensifying Chinese competition and AI infrastructure spending contraction
fields.summary_ko.1: According to Counterpoint Research, Q3 DRAM market revenue reached $200 billion, a 5x increase year-over-year, with Micron holding a 21% market share, and memory prices are expected to remain strong through 2027
